reviewMethod: Existing review records and 36-template catalog checked first. Local original videos were reviewed with exact-second ffmpeg contact sheets and canonical GIF comparison. Titles and seed text alone are not accepted as evidence. No catalog, seed or cloud mutation performed.

sources.note: New original downloaded by parent; audited locally without downloading another original.

proposedClips.framingNoteZh: 按照示范从斜侧方拍摄，完整拍到约45度上斜凳、双肩、双肘、两只哑铃和落地双脚。保持掌心相对，按教学控制下降幅度；这是9秒短节选，包含一轮完整下放与上推，不是平板或正手推胸。
proposedClips.framingNoteEn: Match the oblique side view, including the roughly 45-degree incline bench, shoulders, elbows, both dumbbells and planted feet. Keep palms facing each other and control the lowering range as taught. This nine-second excerpt contains one complete lowering-and-pressing cycle, not a flat or pronated press.
proposedClips.visualEvidence: Canonical 0321-PG1kcIb GIF confirms incline bilateral neutral-grip dumbbell press. Source shows the same incline and palms-facing grip with planted feet. At 196s the instructor begins the recommended technique; 199s subtitle explicitly confirms it is correct. 202s shows the lower position, 203s the upward phase, and 204s the upper position. The 192–195s rejected technique and 206–212s excessive-range counterexample are excluded. Nine seconds is intentionally shorter than the preferred 10–30s; extending it would introduce a counterexample. Later 390–415s is single-arm/static discussion; 570–574s is a brief static bilateral hold, not a complete better repetition.

alreadyCovered.reason: Flat barbell press, incline dumbbell press and unassisted parallel-bar dip already have approved catalog clips; do not count another source range as another exercise.
Clean flat bilateral dumbbell press 1240–1265s already approved.
Cable kickback, flat EZ behind-head extension and incline bilateral dumbbell curl already approved; older arms-private pending note for 0315 was superseded by batch2-upper approval.
Standing EZ curl 686–710s already approved. Coarse exact-time checks of the 815s original found no separately matched new exercise.

rejected.reason: Reinspection at 3645–3670, 3780–3825 and 4090–4105 shows an EZ curved bar, whereas all three canonical templates use a straight bar. Several portions also contain wrist/upper-arm corrections or hands-on coaching. Do not map by the generic lying-triceps chapter name.

Source curl is incline bilateral supinated curl already assigned to 0315. 0317 has effectively the same bilateral incline pattern and is not counted again using the same source repetition; 0318 is alternating, 0322 flared inner curl, and 0350/1661 flat bench. These are not distinct additional matches.

Floor-seated forward cable curls in these sources do not establish the canonical bench-seated dual-high-pulley, overhead bench, squat-low-pulley, regular seated low-cable or standing reverse-grip variants. Retain the exact-variant exclusions from arms-private; no title-based coverage added.
Overhead bare-cable-end extension is not upright pushdown 0231. A matching reverse/underhand handle grip for 1727 is not established.

Previously reviewed weighted material is flat bilateral pronated press or correction-focused seated shoulder press. No exact clean additional incline/decline/neutral/reverse/twisting/alternating/single-arm variant established.
Standing cable Y chapter does not match prone incline dumbbell Y, band Y or conventional lateral raise; unchanged from prior review.
Approved clip is incline neutral grip: not flat neutral-grip 0352 and not pronated incline press 0314.
Excessive lowering range is explicitly shown as a counterexample; do not append to the short positive clip.
